2607.18230.title: Simple Domain Generalization for Strong Pixel-Level Image Tampering Detection in Modern VLMs
2607.18230.paper_summary: Modern vision-language models (VLMs) have significantly improved image generation and editing capabilities, making pixel-level image tampering detection increasingly important yet challenging under cross-model and out-of-distribution shifts. This work studies domain generalization for pixel-level image tampering detection in modern VLMs like ChatGPT, Gemini, Qwen-Image, etc., aiming to learn tampering localization models that remain robust across diverse VLM-generated manipulation distributions. We propose a simple yet effective domain-generalized training framework built on two practical strategies. First, we introduce a balanced minibatch sampling scheme that strategically samples tampered and real images in each minibatch, preventing biased optimization toward either manipulated artifacts or clean-image priors and avoiding training collapse, ensuring that each optimization step receives proper sampled gradient signals. Second, we adopt a simple late-injection strategy, where the detector is first trained on large-scale base data until stable convergence, and then exposed to a small amount of newly selected supporting data from emerging VLM distributions, improving adaptability without overfitting to limited new domains. Together, these components provide a simple yet strong recipe for improving pixel-level tampering localization and OOD robustness across modern VLMs. Despite the conceptual simplicity, our framework outperforms the prior state-of-the-art PIXAR by a large margin of 26.1% and 26.8% relative improvement in average gIoU and cIoU, respectively, across OOD VLMs of GPT-Images-2.0, Gemini-3.1, FLUX.2, and Seedream 4.5. Our code is available at https://github.com/VILA-Lab/PIXAR-DG
2607.18230.paper_summary_zh: 現代的視覺-語言模型（VLMs）顯著提升了圖像生成和編輯的能力，使得像素級圖像篡改檢測在跨模型和分佈外變化下變得越來越重要但也充滿挑戰。本研究探討了現代 VLMs（如 ChatGPT、Gemini、Qwen-Image 等）中像素級圖像篡改檢測的領域泛化，旨在學習在多樣的 VLM 生成操作分佈中保持穩健的篡改定位模型。我們提出了一個簡單但有效的領域泛化訓練框架，基於兩個實用策略。首先，我們引入了一種平衡的小批量抽樣方案，該方案在每個小批量中策略性地抽樣篡改和真實圖像，防止對篡改工件或乾淨圖像先驗的偏見優化，避免訓練崩潰，確保每個優化步驟接收到適當的抽樣梯度信號。其次，我們採用了一種簡單的晚期注入策略，首先在大規模基礎數據上訓練檢測器，直到穩定收斂，然後將其暴露於來自新興 VLM 分佈的小量新選擇支持數據中，提高適應性而不過擬合於有限的新領域。這些組件共同提供了一個簡單但強大的方案，以改善現代 VLMs 中的像素級篡改定位和 OOD 穩健性。儘管概念上簡單，我們的框架在 OOD VLMs（如 GPT-Images-2.0、Gemini-3.1、FLUX.2 和 Seedream 4.5）中，平均 gIoU 和 cIoU 相對提升分別達到 26.1% 和 26.8%，大幅超越了先前的最先進技術 PIXAR。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/VILA-Lab/PIXAR-DG 獲得。
